subject.title: Control UI: upload agent avatars from Agents tab

question: Should OpenClaw add a workspace-persistent Agents-tab avatar upload RPC/UI, and what storage, validation, auth scope, and identity-precedence policy should it use?
rationale: The missing feature is source-proven, but it defines a new image-upload and workspace-write boundary that automation should not choose without maintainer intent.

options.title: Approve bounded upload design
options.body: Add a narrow operator-admin upload path that stores validated images under the agent workspace, updates canonical identity metadata, and keeps current read-only avatar serving protections.

options.title: Keep local and CLI paths only
options.body: Keep Quick Settings browser-local overrides plus manual CLI/config/IDENTITY.md identity management, avoiding a server-side upload surface for now.

options.title: Defer to broader identity UX
options.body: Hold this until maintainers design a full Control UI identity-management surface instead of adding a one-off avatar upload path.

recommendation.title: Approve bounded upload design
recommendation.body: Add a narrow operator-admin upload path that stores validated images under the agent workspace, updates canonical identity metadata, and keeps current read-only avatar serving protections.

likelyOwner.reason: steipete is tied to the original avatar support merge and the security-sensitive Gateway/Control UI avatar boundary.
